prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='FT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) matching y_true's trend pattern, while FT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.3828 correlation). ONLY_CWT_rf dominates overall with lowest RMSE (147.54) and excels across both early and late horizons. High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 10.94) and split trend/seasonality champions suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to combine ARIMA's trend strength with FT_catboost's seasonal expertise.
